body:
**Claude finished @cmungall's task in 7m 49s** —— [View job](https://github.com/ai4curation/ai-gene-review/actions/runs/42359942965)

---
### Review: Audit comparative Lol lipoprotein extraction and delivery

- [x] Schema validation passes — *not re-run locally (`just`/`uv` unavailable in this runner); relying on CI + the PR's own receipt*
- [x] All PMIDs verified as real
- [x] Supporting text matches publication content (spot-checked)
- [x] GO terms correct and specific — *one granularity inconsistency, below*
- [x] Review actions well-justified — *templated reasons, below*
- [x] Core functions accurately identified
- [x] No over-annotation issues missed

This is careful, well-scoped comparative work. The non-deterministic checks I ran: all nine new PMIDs resolve to real cached records with PMCIDs/DOIs; quotes I sampled from `PMID_42736309` and `PMID_36716372` are verbatim; annotation-row counts are preserved (`ECOLI/lolC` 20→20, `ECOLI/lolE` 17→17, `PSEPK/lolC` 6→6); no GOA file is cited as support; `GO:0044874`'s non-descent from `GO:0042953` is backed by the fetched ancestry receipt and used consistently. Five 🟡 items below, then what I think is genuinely good.

---

### 🟡 IMPORTANT

**1. The four LolB-family genes get three different outer-membrane CC treatments on the same evidence class.**

- `genes/ECOLI/lolB/lolB-ai-review.yaml` — `GO:0009279` **MODIFY** → `GO:0031241`, reasoned from "the lipid anchor and periplasm-facing functional domain"
- `genes/FLAJ1/Fjoh_1066/Fjoh_1066-ai-review.yaml:37` — `GO:0031241` proposed **NEW** from "SPII signal/lipid-anchor architecture"
- `genes/ACIAD/lolB/lolB-ai-review.yaml:13` — **ACCEPT** `GO:0009279`, and `GO:0009279` as the core location, despite `SIGNAL 1..21` + `LIPID 22` + `TIGR00548` in the record
- `genes/PSEPK/lolB/lolB-ai-review.yaml:7` — **ACCEPT** `GO:0009279`, same situation (HAMAP MF_00233)

The module takes the ECOLI side against its own gene reviews: `modules/bacterial_lol_lipoprotein_trafficking.yaml:574-578` gives the classical-LolB annoton `locations: GO:0031241`, and its `representative_members` are P61320, **Q88PX4 and Q6F8J1** — the two proteins whose reviews stop at `GO:0009279`. Per CLAUDE.md ("correct but general terms are `MODIFY`"), either make those two MODIFY → `GO:0031241`, or state what ADP1/KT2440 lack that E. coli and *F. johnsoniae* have. [Fix this →](https://claude.ai/code?q=On%20branch%20cmungall%2Faigr-lol-taxon-audit%2C%20align%20outer-membrane%20CC%20granularity%20for%20the%20LolB-family%20genes.%20genes%2FECOLI%2FlolB%20MODIFIEs%20GO%3A0009279%20to%20GO%3A0031241%20and%20modules%2Fbacterial_lol_lipoprotein_trafficking.yaml%20line%20574%20gives%20the%20classical-LolB%20annoton%20GO%3A0031241%2C%20but%20genes%2FACIAD%2FlolB%2FlolB-ai-review.yaml%20line%2013%20and%20genes%2FPSEPK%2FlolB%2FlolB-ai-review.yaml%20line%207%20ACCEPT%20GO%3A0009279%20and%20use%20it%20as%20the%20core%20location%20on%20the%20same%20evidence%20class%20(signal%20peptide%20plus%20lipid%20anchor%20plus%20TIGR00548%2FHAMAP%20MF_00233).%20Either%20change%20those%20two%20to%20MODIFY%20with%20proposed_replacement_terms%20GO%3A0031241%2C%20or%20record%20in%20each%20reason%20what%20target-specific%20evidence%20ADP1%20and%20KT2440%20lack.&repo=ai4curation/ai-gene-review)

**2. Templated `reason` text leaks the other gene's content.** `genes/PSEPK/lolD/lolD-ai-review.yaml:147` and `genes/PSEPK/lolB/lolB-ai-review.yaml:84` carry the identical sentence:

> The product performs transport work itself (terminal transfer/insertion for LolB or ATP-driven release for LolD).

In each file half of that is about the other gene. Separately, "`Assignment to KT2440 is an ortholog inference; the cited E. coli experiments are not assays of this target`" is pasted into **23** `reason` fields across the five PSEPK reviews, including rows whose issue is purely ontological specificity (`GO:0016020` → `GO:0005886`, `GO:0044873` → `GO:0044874`). A `reason` should justify its own row; the shared caveat belongs once in `description` or the notes file.

**3. Module `UniProtKB:` term labels are curator-authored descriptions, not record names.**

| line | accession | module label | UniProt `DE` |
|---|---|---|---|
| 605 | A5FL25 | `LolB1` | `SubName: Full=Hypothetical lipoprotein` |
| 558 | Q6F8J1 | `Lipoprotein insertase LolB` | `Outer-membrane lipoprotein LolB` |
| 379 | Q9EYM2 | `Lipoprotein-release ATPase LolD` | `Lipoprotein-releasing system ATP-binding protein LolD` |
| 350 | A0ACM8PZZ0 | `Lipoprotein-release membrane subunit LolF` | `Transport protein of outer membrane lipoproteins (ABC superfamily, membrane)` |

The PANTHER labels in the same file *are* correctly verbatim (`PTHR42798:SF2` = "ABC TRANSPORTER ATP-BINDING PROTEIN MG467-RELATED"), and `preferred_term` already carries the readable intent — so this is inconsistent within the file, and it is the failure mode CLAUDE.md's PANTHER rule guards against: a plausible label makes a wrong accession invisible. A5FL25 is the one that matters most, since the label asserts a functional identity the record does not carry.

**4. One `proposed_name`, two definitions and inconsistent parents.** "outer-membrane lipoprotein insertion activity" appears in four gene files: `ECOLI/lolB` and `ACIAD/lolB` define it as "Accepting a mature lipoprotein from a periplasmic carrier and promoting incorporation of its lipid anchor…" with `proposed_parent: GO:0140318`; `FLAJ1/Fjoh_1066` and `CAUVC/CC_3705` define it as "Promoting incorporation of the lipid anchor of a mature lipoprotein into the bacterial outer membrane." with no `proposed_parent`. `just export-proposed-terms` aggregates by name, so these will collide in one row of the output table.

**5. `Fjoh_2111` — the qualifier and `core_functions` disagree, and `GO:0044874` is treated two ways.** The accepted row carries CACAO's `acts_upstream_of_or_within_positive_effect`, but `core_functions.directly_involved_in` lists `GO:0042953` (`Fjoh_2111-ai-review.yaml:103`). If LolA1 performs the carriage itself — which the review argues at length — the qualifier understates it, and that is a `source_defects` / MODIFY candidate rather than a plain ACCEPT. Relatedly, `GO:0044874` sits in `directly_involved_in` (line 105) while the `reason` explicitly declines to annotate it — whereas the sibling `Fjoh_1066` and `CC_3705` reviews *do* propose `GO:0044874` as NEW. Pick one treatment across the three.

### 🔵 SUGGESTION

**6. The new-term justification should dismiss `GO:0032977`.** The justification rules out `GO:0140598` and `GO:0140306` but not `GO:0032977 membrane insertase activity`, the nearest existing MF. It genuinely doesn't fit — its definition requires a transmembrane-domain-containing client, whereas LolB's cargo is lipid-anchored — but a GO editor will ask first. Saying so would make the proposal much harder to reject. The repo already works through `GO:0032977` in `genes/ECOLI/bamA`.

**7.** `PSEPK/lolD` `GO:0005524` moved KEEP_AS_NON_CORE → ACCEPT with a sound reason (binding is substrate engagement in the core cycle, not a broad parent of hydrolysis), and `ACIAD/lolD` matches — so the PR is self-consistent. Minor: ACCEPT reads as "core" while ATP binding isn't in `core_functions`.

---

### What's good here

- **Deep research was genuinely attempted and honestly reported.** Falcon returned HTTP 403; the exact log is preserved (`aciad-consultation/lolA-falcon-attempt.log`), the notes record it (`ACIAD/lolA/lolA-notes.md:15`), and no provider-named file was fabricated. That is exactly the CLAUDE.md requirement, and it is the right call under pressure to produce one.
- **`ECOLI/lolA` evidence upgrade.** Two generic large-scale-proteomics method quotes ("…assigned to the cytosol, periplasm, inner membrane…", "…reference maps…were constructed and compared") are replaced with the targeted purification quote from PMID:7628437, with the `reason` openly stating the original is abstract-only and its target-level table was not re-extracted. Real improvement, honestly labelled.
- **`PSEPK/lolD` `GO:0055085` REMOVE** now rests on PMID:29109272 full text ("LolCDE and FtsEX do not transport substrates across the inner membrane…") instead of a deep-research file quote.
- **`PSEPK/lolB` `GO:0015031`** MARK_AS_OVER_ANNOTATED → MODIFY with `GO:0042953` — the correct action for a true-but-broad term.
- **The insertion claims are scoped correctly.** `CC_3705` and `Fjoh_1066` route the terminal activity through `proposed_molecular_function` rather than a fabricated GO id, and `CC_3705`'s review states the construct boundary plainly: the robust complementation uses cviLolA**eco** with a swapped C-terminus, native cviLolA "was very poor", and the in vitro insertase assay was negative for the related chimera. Three NEW rows on a gene with an empty GOA file is aggressive, but each is hedged to what the paper actually supports.
- **ADP1 identity work holds up.** `PTHR42798:SF2` for ADP1 LolD vs `PTHR24220:SF689` for canonical LolD matches the UniProt records; the `A0ACM8PZZ0`/`Q9EYM3` sequence identity and the LolC-named-but-LolF-functioning subunit are documented rather than silently reconciled, including a `source_defects` entry against the inherited HAMAP SUBUNIT sentence.
- The ECO-only import fix (`etl/gene.py`, `goa_validator.py`, schema) is minimal and correct; `ECO:0007744`'s description matches the fetched ECO label verbatim.

None of the 🟡 items question the biology — they are consistency and provenance-hygiene issues in a PR whose whole point is cross-taxon consistency, so they are worth fixing before merge rather than after.
 · branch `cmungall/aigr-lol-taxon-audit`
